note: pixel coords (x right, y down). All values est from pixel scans; +-3 px unless noted.

ship_aft_flap_flare.note: widest black section, aft flaps and hot-stage ring shoulder

booster_engine_plane_base.note: bright plume begins at y about 441

booster_frost_change.note: above this row booster is dark grey-blue (RGB 60-75,70-80,80-90); below it lighter frost (100-118). Estimated common dome / LOX-CH4 boundary about 45 m above booster base

m_per_px_at_rocket.ref: ship 88 px = 52 m, booster 119 px = 72.3 m

camera_est.ref: assumes drone wide lens; distance from px scale; height from tower base 150 px below horizon

facing.ship: black windward/tile side toward camera; right edge glints (sun from right)
facing.booster: camera sees a side with heavy frost below the dome line; grid fins not resolvable
facing.tower: left of and slightly behind the rocket; plume overlaps its right part

frost_pattern: lower about 60% of booster (below y=366) is bright mottled frost; upper about 40% is darker grey-blue near-bare steel with thin frost. Est: LOX tank below about 45 m, CH4 above.

rocket_altitude_est.ref: 84 px above horizon = 3.7 deg at 800 m, camera 95 m up => about 145 m above ground
